name: Caterpie
flavour_text: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

name: Metapod
flavour_text: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can’t withstand a harsh attack.

name: Butterfree
flavour_text: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

name: Cacnea
flavour_text: It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom once a year.

name: Tropius
flavour_text: Delicious fruits grew out from around its neck because it always ate the same kind of fruit.

name: Petilil
flavour_text: If the leaves on its head are pruned with regularity, this Pokémon can be grown into a fine plump shape.

name: Hisuian Lilligant
flavour_text: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

name: Vulpix
flavour_text: As its body grows larger, its six warm tails become more beautiful, with a more luxurious coat of fur.

name: Ninetales
flavour_text: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.

name: Growlithe
flavour_text: It’s very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

name: Psyduck
flavour_text: If its chronic headache peaks, it may exhibit odd powers. It seems unable to recall such an episode.

name: Goldeen
flavour_text: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.

name: Seaking
flavour_text: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.

name: Feebas
flavour_text: It is the shabbiest Pokémon of all. It forms schools and lives at the bottom of rivers that teem with plant life.

name: Snorunt
flavour_text: It is said that a home visited by a Snorunt will prosper. It can withstand cold of −150 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Froslass
flavour_text: It freezes prey by blowing its −58 degree Fahrenheit breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

name: Luvdisc
flavour_text: During the spawning season, countless Luvdisc congregate at coral reefs, turning the waters pink.

name: Piplup
flavour_text: It doesn’t like to be taken care of. It’s difficult to bond with since it won’t listen to its Trainer.

name: Iron Bundle
flavour_text: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.

name: Pikachu
flavour_text: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

name: Raichu
flavour_text: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

name: Emolga
flavour_text: This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries. Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much food that it can’t fly properly.

name: Yamper
flavour_text: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

name: Slowpoke
flavour_text: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

name: Slowbro
flavour_text: If the tail-biting Shellder is thrown off in a harsh battle, this Pokémon reverts to being an ordinary Slowpoke.

name: Munna
flavour_text: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it’s eating a good dream, and black when it’s eating a nightmare.

name: Musharna
flavour_text: It drowses and dreams all the time. It’s best to leave it be if it’s just woken up, as it’s a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.

name: Sylveon
flavour_text: Sylveon cuts an elegant figure as it dances lightly around, feelers fluttering, but its piercing moves aim straight for its opponents’ weak spots.

name: Carbink
flavour_text: It’s said that somewhere in the world, there’s a mineral vein housing a large pack of slumbering Carbink. It’s also said that this pack has a queen.

name: Enamorus
flavour_text: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon’s love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

name: Fidough
flavour_text: The yeast in Fidough’s breath is useful for cooking, so this Pokémon has been protected by people since long ago.

name: Flutter Mane
flavour_text: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common.

name: Wooper
flavour_text: When it walks around on land, it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous film.

name: Quagsire
flavour_text: Its body is always slimy. It often bangs its head on the river bottom as it swims but seems not to care.

name: Rockruff
flavour_text: This Pokémon travels in a pack with others until it grows up. When its mood turns sour, it starts striking the ground with the rocks on its neck.

name: Sandygast
flavour_text: It flings sand into the eyes of its prey and tries to close in on them while they’re blinded, but since Sandygast is so slow, the prey tends to escape.

name: Palossand
flavour_text: From the hollows in its arms, it fires the bones of its victims, which are all dried up after being drained of their vitality.

name: Cacturne
flavour_text: It lives in deserts. It becomes active at night when it hunts for prey exhausted from the desert’s heat.

name: Spiritomb
flavour_text: It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from doing any mischief.

name: Scraggy
flavour_text: It will abruptly headbutt anyone that makes eye contact with it. Its skull is extremely hard.

name: Scrafty
flavour_text: This Pokémon may be rude, but it takes very good care of its family, its friends, and its turf.

name: Mareanie
flavour_text: It has excellent regenerative capabilities. Legs that a Mareanie has lost have a very bitter, astringent flavor—they’re not suitable as food.

name: Toxapex
flavour_text: Toxapex gets into fierce battles with Bruxish over areas where warm ocean currents flow, but the odds are always against it.

name: Goomy
flavour_text: Goomy’s horns are excellent sensory organs that cover all five of Goomy’s senses. Goomy picks up on danger from the movement of the air.

name: Hisuian Sliggoo
flavour_text: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui’s water.

name: Hisuian Goodra
flavour_text: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

name: Jigglypuff
flavour_text: If it inflates to sing a lullaby, it can perform longer and cause sure drowsiness in its audience.

name: Wigglytuff
flavour_text: The rich, fluffy fur that covers its body feels so good that anyone who feels it can’t stop touching it.

name: Eevee
flavour_text: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element stones.

name: Munchlax
flavour_text: When it is voraciously gulping down food, it forgets about the food it has hidden under its fur.

name: Snorlax
flavour_text: Its stomach’s digestive juices can dissolve any kind of poison. Eating things off the ground doesn’t bother it at all.

name: Teddiursa
flavour_text: Its paws are soaked in oodles of honey. When nervous, Teddiursa will lick its paws and soon have a smile back on its face.

name: Ursaring
flavour_text: It is quite skilled at climbing trees. If it comes across a Primeape while searching for berries in the treetops, trouble will surely ensue.

name: Ursaluna
flavour_text: I believe it was Hisui’s swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

name: Hisuian Zorua
flavour_text: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

name: Furfrou
flavour_text: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

name: Skwovet
flavour_text: No matter how much it stuffs its belly with food, it is always anxious about getting hungry again. So, it stashes berries in its cheeks and tail.

name: Greedent
flavour_text: This Pokémon makes off with heaps of fallen berries by wrapping them in its tail, which is roughly twice the length of its body.

name: Vulpix
flavour_text: As its body grows larger, its six warm tails become more beautiful, with a more luxurious coat of fur.

name: Butterfree

name: Mareep
flavour_text: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

name: Flaaffy
flavour_text: Because of its rubbery, electricity-resistant skin, it can store lots of electricity in its fur.

name: Ampharos
flavour_text: When it gets dark, the light from its bright, shiny tail can be seen from far away on the ocean’s surface.

name: Slowbro
flavour_text: If the tail-biting Shellder is thrown off in a harsh battle, this Pokémon reverts to being an ordinary Slowpoke.

name: Kangaskhan
flavour_text: There are records of a lost human child being raised by a childless Kangaskhan.

name: Ditto
flavour_text: It can freely recombine its own cellular structure to transform into other life-forms.
